core.name: E‑Design (Virtual)

core.name: Full Residential Design (Turnkey)
core.desc: Concept through install—materials, custom pieces, trades and deliveries handled for you—so you leave a ‘before’ and come home to the ‘after.’

core.name: Home Staging
core.desc: Market‑ready rooms styled to photograph beautifully and show even better—edited furniture, art, and accents that spotlight light, space, and flow.

core.name: Small Commercial / Boutique
core.desc: Brand‑minded interiors for salons, cafés, and studios—optimized floor plans, durable finishes, and ‘stop‑and‑shoot’ moments that convert foot traffic.

addons.name: Move‑In Styling

addons.name: Paint & Color Direction
addons.desc: A cohesive palette for walls, trim, ceilings, and key finishes—with sheen specs and room‑by‑room placement so painters just roll.

addons.name: Personal Sourcing Day
addons.desc: A designer on your arm—showrooms to checkout—pulling options, securing trade pricing, and leaving you with a ready‑to‑order cart.

addons.name: Art Curation & Gallery Walls
addons.desc: A curated art plan with scaled mockups and a hanging map—so every piece lands at the right height and tells the right story.

addons.name: Holiday / Event Styling
addons.desc: One‑day transformation for photos, parties, or rentals—tablescapes, mantel moments, florals, and layered lighting you can recreate next season.

addons.name: Space Planning & Layout
addons.desc: Scaled floor plans that unlock sightlines and circulation—right‑sized furniture, clear dimensions, and a map for confident buying.

addons.name: Finish & Fixture Selections (Kitchen/Bath)
addons.desc: Clean, cohesive specs—countertops, tile, plumbing, hardware, and paint that play together beautifully from sample to install.

addons.name: Lighting Plan

addons.name: Window Treatments
